The Report Noisy Max mechanism states that if we have a set of $d$ score functions $S_j(D)$, each with a global sensitivity of $\Delta S$, then adding independent Laplace noise with a scale parameter of $\Delta S / \varepsilon_{DP}$ to each score and returning the index of the maximum noisy score provides $\varepsilon_{DP}$-differential privacy.
